8	head/evals/harness/ablation-report.py:1135 — part_rule() reads any review-catch row without a grader_rule as "pm3", but the row writer leaves grader_rule null on every ungraded review-catch row (agent_error, cap_failure, infrastructure_error, transport_error: $rc is null). In a grader-1.3 batch a single failed review-catch row therefore forms its own "<version> · rule pm3" partition and leaves the graded rows' partition, so the primary partition's excluded share (the DEC-0393 degradation guard), by_status counts and the Exclusions table no longer see it. Reproduced: turning one a1_full rc-01 row of the c131 fixture into agent_error yields partitions "3 · rule pm3" (1 row, H1 inconclusive by degradation) and "3 · rule pm3_or_same_function" (47 rows, "H1: established", dropped 0).
